title: The quoted figure becomes the number the viewer feels

members.role: the figure the market quotes is WRITTEN at its datum by the hand (E50) - '24.8x'
the page-species carrier for the verb
the quoted number's OUTLINES sag and BALL UP at the same datum, and the ball is MORPHED into the comparator's glyphs - '15% dearer' - the arithmetic authored (E77)
the outlines the morph needs, measured off the page's own ink by marching squares - no font file is parsed (E76 s5)

does: A market figure is shown as quoted, then MELTS INTO A BALL and the ball becomes what it means: one datum, two numbers - the multiple nobody feels becomes the percentage everybody does (E76).
source: P57 T12 golden compare-morph (figure at 6.0 s, compare at 12.0 s), re-goldened onto the melt by P57 T12b and onto E76 s5's ball-then-morph by P57 T12c - no approved cut has carried it
